title: Ninja 500 SE
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Kawasaki Ninja 500 SE is engineered for responsive agility and high-rpm engine exhilaration. At its heart lies a 500cc powertrain delivering 40 HP and 35 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 165 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 13.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
